title: Third Autocorrelation Inequality (Upper Bound)
solution_format: {"values": [f_0, ..., f_{n-1}]}, 1 <= n <= 100,000 numbers of either sign, (sum(f) * 0.5 / n)^2 >= 1e-9

limits.notes: max_values is the zod schema of the pinned commit (z.array(num).min(1).max(100_000)); the live API only serves the text 'array of floats (the discretized function values, may be negative)'. Values may be negative. The score is invariant under f -> a*f, but validity is not: the verifier rejects (sum(f) * 0.5 / n)^2 < 1e-9. Minimize: a lower score is better.

verifier.harness: server prefixes 'import json' and calls evaluate(solution) (web/src/app/api/evaluate/route.ts)

record.note: Snapshot only. The record to beat is always the LIVE #1 (problem.best_known_score()).

certificate.sha256_of: decompressed bytes, identical to GET /api/solutions/best for this solution

proposal: Proposed change of main problem, frozen on the branch ws1/freeze-third-autocorrelation. Arthur has not yet accepted the proposal: the problem is not registered in problems/catalog.py, and the main problem is still second-autocorrelation-inequality.
